decisions.reason: The original Definition admits the unit seed ball for F(x,lambda)=x+x^3 and initial section lambda=0: x=0 is a regular global branch and the augmented residual has exactly one zero. At its center DG=I, so every sound beta is at least 1; the derivative diag(1+3x^2,1) requires L at least 6 on the unit ball (difference quotients as x approaches 1), hence q=beta*L*R is at least 6. Step 1 returns this seed immediately when N_req=0, contradicting the promised contraction record for every output ball. The repair preserves that output promise by requiring the initial seed to carry all hypotheses, bounds and inequalities of the existing contraction theorem, plus whole-ball tube/chart inclusion and initial angle data. No external theorem or new prerequisite is needed.
